summary: Iteration 16 checked the fixes from iteration 15 in Chromium at 375x667, with nur.lang set to 'fr'. Backend: after a restart, pytest tests/ -q -p no:randomly gave 149 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed. FIX A (recording timer) PASS: the status counted 'JE VOUS ÉCOUTE… 0:01' up to 0:05, then showed 'TRANSCRIPTION…', and the next recording restarted at 0:00. FIX B (Protocol dots) PASS: the diagnosis response was intercepted to add a white and a cyan day; in light mode the white dot has a #5C5C5C rim, cyan #0B7FA3 and yellow #8F6B00. FIX C (welcome dots) PASS: in both dark and light mode all 7 dots stay at opacity 1 with full colour, and only the halo pulses (opacity about 0.25 to 0.8, scale 1 to 1.35). FIX D (blocked mic on web) PASS: with permission 'denied' the sheet opens straight away with the 'bloqué pour ce site' copy and coach-mic-type ('Écrire ma question'); there is no settings or allow button, and the button closes the sheet. FIX E is PARTIAL: the 429 message 'Trop de demandes. Réessayez dans quelques minutes.' PASS; the tab label AUJOURD'HUI is no longer cut (scrollWidth equals clientWidth) PASS; the code-input placeholder 'Mon code d’accès' is STILL cut ('Mon code d’accè' is visible). Non-regression PASS: a partial code sends no request, a full typed code waits for the button, the button activates and goes to /onboarding, the paste chip submits, 6 digits auto-validate (5 digits send nothing), Mes produits saves and survives a reload with the red error line on a 500, magic and invite links sign in, and a reused magic link shows 'Lien expiré'. The e-mail provider (integrations email/send) returned 429 during this run, so request-code returned 503 email_unavailable and the app showed the correct 'momentanément indisponible' message. The OTP UI flow was therefore checked with an OTP seeded in the database. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: The upstream e-mail provider returned 429 Too Many Requests during testing, so the endpoint returned 503 email_unavailable. This is an external quota, most likely used up by the pytest suite sending real e-mails. The app handled it correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: The placeholder 'Mon code d’accès' is still cut off at 375px wide: it shows 'Mon code d’accè'. The inputCode style (fontSize 24, letterSpacing 6) also applies to the placeholder, giving about 307px of text in a 289px content box. Reference: /app/frontend/app/activate.tsx:296

issues: The title still says 'Autoriser le micro' while the body says the mic is blocked. A title like 'Micro bloqué' would match the body (coach.tsx:596).
'Écrire ma question' only closes the sheet: focus stays on coach-mic, not coach-input. Focus the text input so the CTA does what it says.

The halo is a solid disc in the same colour (22px, up to 0.8 opacity, scaled to 1.35x) behind an 11px dot. The red, blue, green and violet dots keep the dark #1F1F1F border rim, so each LED looks like a target (dot, dark ring, disc) rather than a glow. Consider borderWidth 0 in dark mode for those colours, or a softer halo.
The tab labels use fontSize 8.5px, which is below a legible minimum of about 10 to 11px. The labels are no longer cut, but they are very small.

action_items: activate.tsx: make the code-input placeholder fit at 375px: use letterSpacing 0 and a smaller fontSize while the value is empty, or use a shorter placeholder.
coach.tsx:596: when micSheet==='blocked' on web, use a 'Micro bloqué' type title instead of 'Autoriser le micro'. Make coach-mic-type also focus coach-input.
Optional: drop the dark #1F1F1F rim on the welcome LED dots in dark mode so they glow instead of looking like targets. Consider raising the tab label font to at least 10px.
critical_code_review_comments: coach.tsx is about 800 lines, above the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting the mic and camera sheets and the recording logic into hooks or components.
The elapsed counter starts with setInterval when turn becomes 'listening' and resets when it leaves 'listening', which is correct.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/seed_otp.py (new helper: seeds an OTP when the e-mail provider is rate-limited)

success_rate.frontend: about 93% (14 of 15 checks; only the placeholder truncation fails)

seed_data_creation: New NUR-CREATOR, OTP, magic and invite users with delivered+t1i16*@resend.dev e-mails. demo-charts-user own_products was set back to ''. The Protocol white and cyan days were injected with Playwright route interception only, not written to the database.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The backend was restarted after testing because the per-IP rate limits are in memory. Set localStorage nur.lang='fr'. The protocol-title element is hidden (opacity 0), so wait with state='attached'. For the mic, stub navigator.permissions.query and getUserMedia (an OscillatorNode into MediaStreamDestination) in add_init_script and toggle window.__micState. If the e-mail provider returns 429, run python /app/backend/tests/seed_otp.py <email>, then use gate-have-code after typing the e-mail. Magic and invite tokens: python /app/backend/tests/seed_magic_token.py.
rca_of_issue: Placeholder truncation: on react-native-web the TextInput placeholder inherits the input's fontSize 24 and letterSpacing 6. 'Mon code d’accès' is 16 characters, which is about 307px against a 289px box at a 375px viewport.
